title: Spread rate of infections: R0 vs serial interval

columns.name: Label.
columns.r0_low_x: Lowest known basic reproduction number of the class.
columns.r0_high_x: Highest known basic reproduction number of the class.
columns.r0_example_x: Basic reproduction number of the marked example object.
columns.r0_max_x: Maximum allowable basic reproduction number; empty if none.
columns.source_url: Primary source for the values (journal DOI, agency fact sheet, spec sheet).
columns.citation: Short citation: authors, year, title, venue.
columns.notes: One line shown in the hover tooltip.
